title: 267. Spiral Matrix II

examples.explanation: The outer ring is 1-8 clockwise and the center is 9.
A 1x1 grid holds only the value 1.
Going right gives 1, 2, then down to 3 and left to 4.

hints: Maintain four boundaries (top, bottom, left, right) and fill one edge at a time, shrinking the boundary after each edge.
Place numbers 1 to n*n in order; the loop ends when the top boundary passes the bottom or the left passes the right.
